newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys one jet fuel cargo, seeks a second.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys one jet fuel cargo, seeks a second.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded one jet fuel cargo and is negotiating to buy a second for arrival in November, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
One 32,000-tonne cargo for arrival in end October was awarded to BB Energy at between $246.95-247.00 per tonne cost-and-freight Keelung or Shen Ao, trading sources said.
The CPC source said the company was negotiating with another party for the purchase of a November arrival cargo.
Trading sources said the cargo could be awarded at around $247-248 per tonne but this was not confirmed.
CPC's tender, which closed on October 7, request for the delivery of 32,000-tonnes of jet fuel between November 1-30 to Keelung or Shen Ao.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 32-000-tonne jet fuel cargoes at $244.80 and $247.82 per tonne for October 1-31 delivery, on a c-and-f basis.
